ns2:section.sectionText: This course will meet on the following dates: September 12-13, 26-27, October 10-11, 31-November 1, 14-15. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $592.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
